## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `dev` (`main` only receives releases)
- [ ] Checks pass locally: `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace`, `npm run check && npm test`, `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Screenshots for changes to the interface
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or note contents in code, tests or screenshots
